mapper.sql: select a.alert_id, a.alert_no, a.rule_id, a.rule_code, a.rule_name, a.object_type, a.object_id, a.object_name, a.alert_level, a.score, a.evidence, a.status, a.verify_opinion, a.verify_by, a.verify_time, a.issue_id, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark, i.issue_no as issue_no from jc_risk_alert a left join jc_rectify_issue i on i.issue_id = a.issue_id
mapper.insert: insert into jc_risk_alert (alert_no, rule_id, rule_code, rule_name, object_type, object_id, object_name, alert_level, score, evidence, status, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{alertNo}, #{ruleId}, #{ruleCode}, #{ruleName}, #{objectType}, #{objectId}, #{objectName}, #{alertLevel}, #{score}, #{evidence}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select count(1) as total, sum(case when status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as pending, sum(case when status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as verifying, sum(case when status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as confirmed, sum(case when status = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as excluded, sum(case when alert_level = '2' and status in ('0','1') then 1 else 0 end) as highOpen from jc_risk_alert where del_flag = '0'

select dd.dict_label as name, count(1) as value from jc_risk_alert a left join sys_dict_data dd on dd.dict_type = 'jc_risk_alert_level' and dd.dict_value = a.alert_level where a.del_flag = '0' group by a.alert_level, dd.dict_label, dd.dict_sort order by dd.dict_sort

select dd.dict_label as name, count(1) as value from jc_risk_alert a left join sys_dict_data dd on dd.dict_type = 'jc_risk_alert_status' and dd.dict_value = a.status where a.del_flag = '0' group by a.status, dd.dict_label, dd.dict_sort order by dd.dict_sort
select a.rule_name as name, count(1) as value from jc_risk_alert a where a.del_flag = '0' group by a.rule_id, a.rule_name order by value desc

select date_format(a.create_time, '%Y-%m') as name, count(1) as value from jc_risk_alert a where a.del_flag = '0' and a.create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 11 month) group by date_format(a.create_time, '%Y-%m') order by name

select d.dept_name as name, count(1) as value from jc_risk_alert a join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = a.object_id where a.del_flag = '0' and a.object_type = '1' and a.status in ('0','1') group by a.object_id, d.dept_name order by value desc limit 10
select a.object_name as name, count(1) as value from jc_risk_alert a where a.del_flag = '0' and a.object_type = '0' and a.status in ('0','1') group by a.object_name order by value desc limit 10
